metadata.document_title: The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

article.title: Power to call for information.
article.content: The Commissioner or an officer authorised by him may, by an order, direct any person to furnish information relating to any matter dealt with in connection with this Act, within such time, in such form, and in such manner, as may be specified therein.]
article.html:
1511[Power to call for information.

Section 151 · Chapter XXI · page 117 of the Act

The Commissioner or an officer authorised by him may, by an order, direct any person to furnish information relating to any matter dealt with in connection with this Act, within such time, in such form, and in such manner, as may be specified therein.]

1 Subs. by Act 13 of 2021, s. 119, for section 151 (w.e.f. 1-1-2022).
